_meta.description: This file contains a serialized version of schema entities for drift.

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "profiles" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "display_name" TEXT NULL, "avatar_path" TEXT NULL, "timezone" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'UTC', "week_start" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "currency" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'GBP', "date_format" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'dmy', "onboarded_at" INTEGER NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "preferences" ("user_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("user_id", "key"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "dashboard_cards" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "user_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "visible" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("visible" IN (0, 1)), "size" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'medium', "config" TEXT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NULL, "dirty" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("dirty" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "tasks" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "user_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "due_date" TEXT NULL, "due_time" TEXT NULL, "timezone" TEXT NULL, "priority" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "category_id" TEXT NULL, "project_id" TEXT NULL, "goal_id" TEXT NULL, "recurrence_rule" TEXT NULL, "parent_recurring_id" TEXT NULL, "sort_index" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "completed_at" INTEGER NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "dirty" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("dirty" IN (0, 1)), "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "subtasks" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "task_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "completed_at" INTEGER NULL, "sort_index" REAL NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "dirty" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("dirty" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "plans" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "user_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'plan', "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "icon" TEXT NULL, "colour" TEXT NULL, "category" TEXT NULL, "media_type" TEXT NULL, "rule" TEXT NOT NULL, "generation_version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "anchor_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "start_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "end_date" TEXT NULL, "end_after_count" INTEGER NULL, "time_of_day" TEXT NULL, "duration_minutes" INTEGER NULL, "target" TEXT NULL, "reminder_offsets" TEXT NULL, "missed_policy" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'markMissed', "schedule_mode" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'fixed', "grace_days" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "pause_from" TEXT NULL, "pause_until" TEXT NULL, "goal_id" TEXT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "sort_index" REAL NULL, "archived_at" INTEGER NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "dirty" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("dirty" IN (0, 1)), "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "plan_occurrences" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "plan_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "user_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "scheduled_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "scheduled_time" TEXT NULL, "original_date" TEXT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', "completed_at" INTEGER NULL, "value_achieved" REAL NULL, "linked_entity_type" TEXT NULL, "linked_entity_id" TEXT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, "is_exception" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_exception" IN (0, 1)), "generation_version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "created_at" INTEGER NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "dirty" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("dirty" IN (0, 1)), "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "goals" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "user_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "description" TEXT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "target_value" REAL NULL, "current_value" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "unit" TEXT NULL, "start_date" TEXT NULL, "end_date" TEXT NULL, "colour" TEXT NULL, "icon" TEXT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active', "created_at" INTEGER NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "dirty" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("dirty" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "goal_milestones" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "goal_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NULL, "target_value" REAL NULL, "due_date" TEXT NULL, "completed_at" INTEGER NULL, "sort_index" REAL NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NULL, "dirty" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("dirty" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "goal_contributions" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "goal_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "source_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "source_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" REAL NOT NULL, "date" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NULL, "dirty" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("dirty" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "projects" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "user_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "description" TEXT NULL, "colour" TEXT NULL, "icon" TEXT NULL, "deadline" TEXT NULL, "goal_id" TEXT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active', "sort_index" REAL NULL, "completed_at" INTEGER NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "dirty" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("dirty" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "events" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "user_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "location" TEXT NULL, "start_at" INTEGER NULL, "end_at" INTEGER NULL, "start_date" TEXT NULL, "end_date" TEXT NULL, "all_day" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("all_day" IN (0, 1)), "timezone" TEXT NULL, "colour" TEXT NULL, "recurrence_rule" TEXT NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'local', "external_id" TEXT NULL, "external_calendar_id" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "dirty" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("dirty" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "reminders" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "user_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "fire_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "offset_minutes" INTEGER NULL, "platform_id" INTEGER NULL, "delivered_at" INTEGER NULL, "cancelled_at" INTEGER NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NULL, "dirty" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("dirty" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "library_items" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "user_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "media_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "sort_title" TEXT NULL, "provider_id" TEXT NULL, "external_id" TEXT NULL, "year" INTEGER NULL, "poster_path" TEXT NULL, "backdrop_path" TEXT NULL, "overview" TEXT NULL, "runtime_minutes" INTEGER NULL, "genres" TEXT NULL, "creators" TEXT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'wishlist', "rating" REAL NULL, "is_favourite" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_favourite" IN (0, 1)), "notes" TEXT NULL, "progress_value" REAL NULL, "progress_unit" TEXT NULL, "added_at" INTEGER NULL, "started_at" INTEGER NULL, "finished_at" INTEGER NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "dirty" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("dirty" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "media_metadata_cache" ("provider_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "external_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "media_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "payload" TEXT NOT NULL, "fetched_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("provider_id", "external_id", "media_type"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "collections" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "user_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "description" TEXT NULL, "cover_path" TEXT NULL, "item_type" TEXT NULL, "is_smart" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_smart" IN (0, 1)), "smart_query" TEXT NULL, "sort_index" REAL NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "dirty" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("dirty" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "collection_items" ("collection_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "sort_index" REAL NULL, "added_at" INTEGER NULL, "dirty" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("dirty" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("collection_id", "entity_type", "entity_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "notes" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "user_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NULL, "blocks" TEXT NOT NULL, "plain_text" TEXT NULL, "folder_id" TEXT NULL, "pinned" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("pinned" IN (0, 1)), "colour" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "dirty" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("dirty" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "note_links" ("note_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("note_id", "entity_type", "entity_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "journal_entries" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "user_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "date" TEXT NOT NULL, "blocks" TEXT NULL, "plain_text" TEXT NULL, "mood" INTEGER NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "dirty" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("dirty" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "categories" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "user_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "domain" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "colour" TEXT NULL, "icon" TEXT NULL, "sort_index" REAL NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "dirty" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("dirty" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "expenses" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "user_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL, "currency" TEXT NOT NULL, "category_id" TEXT NULL, "date" TEXT NOT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, "recurrence_rule" TEXT NULL, "attachment_id" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "dirty" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("dirty" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "budgets" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "user_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "category_id" TEXT NULL, "amount_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL, "period" TEXT NOT NULL, "start_date" TEXT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "dirty" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("dirty" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "attachments" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "user_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity_type" TEXT NULL, "entity_id" TEXT NULL, "filename" TEXT NULL, "mime_type" TEXT NULL, "size_bytes" INTEGER NULL, "local_path" TEXT NULL, "remote_path" TEXT NULL, "upload_state" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', "created_at" INTEGER NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "dirty" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("dirty" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "ai_conversations" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "user_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "dirty" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("dirty" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "ai_messages" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "conversation_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "role" TEXT NOT NULL, "content" TEXT NULL, "proposed_actions" TEXT NULL, "executed_actions" TEXT NULL, "token_count" INTEGER NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NULL, "dirty" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("dirty" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "activity_log" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "user_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity_type" TEXT NULL, "entity_id" TEXT NULL, "action" TEXT NULL, "payload" TEXT NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'user', "created_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "daily_rollups" ("user_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "date" TEXT NOT NULL, "tasks_completed" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "tasks_created" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "occurrences_completed" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "occurrences_missed" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "occurrences_skipped" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "habits_completed" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "habits_due" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "films_watched" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "books_finished" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "pages_read" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "study_minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "activity_minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "goal_contributions" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "expense_total_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "journal_written" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "activity_score" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "updated_at" INTEGER NULL, "dirty" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("dirty" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("user_id", "date"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "outbox" ("seq" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "target_table" TEXT NOT NULL, "row_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "op" TEXT NOT NULL, "payload" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NULL, "attempts" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "last_error" TEXT NULL);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_state" ("target_table" TEXT NOT NULL, "last_pulled_at" INTEGER NULL, "last_pushed_seq" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("target_table"));
